semantics.input: Accept one canonical bounded projector envelope after exact Listing, projector, Pack, projection-schema, and Complete-Head verification.
semantics.terminal: Read the configured top-level string field and compare it exactly with the configured terminal value.
semantics.missing_outcome: Return terminal_without_outcome only when the configured outcome field is canonical null on a terminal projection.
semantics.summary: Copy only configured enum, nullable-identifier, and bounded-integer fields into the pinned summary schema.
semantics.canonicalization: Return only canonical worldstream/canonical-json/v1 bytes within the pinned output byte limit.
semantics.capabilities: No network, clock, randomness, environment, filesystem, process, dynamic code, or Pack-name dispatch.
